messages:
maria: Quick Q on the FRA shipment — vendor split the H100 batch into two AWBs. Do we have confirmed serial -> AWB mapping and RMA routing? Customs flagged an HS code mismatch last time and I want to avoid depot holds. Also need ETA impact and whether vendor covers cross-dock fees.

vendor_ops: Hi — NexaSupply here. We created two AWBs: `AWB123456789DE` (Maersk) and `AWB987654321DE` (DHL). Serial manifest v2 uploaded to the supplier portal (link shared). We will cover first-mile customs clearance for this shipment; depot handling after handoff is on the receiver unless we hit an inspection.

ashwin: Can you paste serial ranges inline? Ops wants to pre-create RMA labels to avoid any manual holdups.

vendor_ops: Serial ranges as requested: H100 units -> `SN-H100-2024-0001..0050` on `AWB123456789DE`, `SN-H100-2024-0051..0100` on `AWB987654321DE`. One DOA flagged during final QA: `SN-H100-2024-0023` — we will swap under RMA but need the depot address for the return routing (suggested depot: `CDX-FRA-3`).

leo: Noted. Current customs HS we should use: `8471.70`. The prior mismatch came from the shipper invoice description. If customs re-inspects, expect +36h delay. Who covers storage if hold >48h?

vendor_ops: We'll absorb storage up to 72h on our side for this exception. Crossdock / last-mile charges after handoff remain per contract. For the DOA swap we'll issue RMA AWB `AWB-SWAP-1001` and push a pre-paid label to `CDX-FRA-3`. Swap ETA: 2 business days after depot receives faulty unit.

maria: OK. Ops can we do a canary routing: keep production requests on dedicated pool but route traffic tied to serials `SN-H100-2024-0020..0030` to a shared pool until swap is complete? Also vendor mentioned a 3% discount on split shipments — finance needs formal confirmation to amend the PO.

ashwin: Acknowledged. I'll draft a PO amendment for the 3% repricing and flag it for review. @leo — please confirm whether the reroute will affect Dedicated pool quotas or billing tags.

leo: Reroute won't change reserved Dedicated GPU capacity, but draining affected nodes may add ~4h to provisioning for those specific hosts while caches flush. I'll create a canary rule: `route.policy = prefer:dedi except serial in [SN-H100-2024-0020..0030] -> host: shared-fra-1` and add a short TTL.

ops-bot: Deploy notice — canary routing rule created by leo at 1732468105 :rocket:

maria: Great. vendor_ops, please DM the updated manifest and both AWB documents to finance and ops once you fix the invoice HS code and pricing. If customs requests commercial invoice v3, ping me and I'll escalate with legal.

vendor_ops: :thumbsup: We'll send updated paperwork and RMA labels to finance@redwood and ops@redwood by EOD CET. Will notify immediately if customs asks for additional docs.
